objective: L = L_Said + 0.1 * L_rec (native CLS/EOS inside the one fine-grained objective; no separate global loss, no warm-up stage)

stages.notes: router query is the candidate text's native global EOS feature, no reduction over text slots; hard gate tie-breaks by ascending slot index; differentiable all_gather for the Said term, explicit world_size factor for the per-sample rec term

covers: last-layer interface (patch tokens, CLS identity, single text projection)
text validity (padding/SOT/EOT excluded, empty caption reported and finite)
aggregation weights over legal tokens only, separate aggregator parameters
gate: exactly 16 of the 32 visual slots, native CLS excluded, deterministic ties
router query is the native global text feature; text slots do not move the gate
hard score equals the manual definition; masked slots removed before the max
proxy forward equals the hard value; proxy carries no gradient to the features
gradient boundary: L_rec touches only image side + decoder, L_Said never the decoder
u mask is the detached complement; reference untouched by an optimizer step
chunking invariance of the objective and the gradients
T0 (lambda_rec = 0) drops the reconstruction term, no SmartCLIP fallback
bare student state loads strictly; module construction does not disturb the global RNG
CLI help/flags and the T0-with-a-weight refusal
2-rank DDP step equals the single-process reference (gradients rtol 1e-5, bit-identical ranks, equal global means)
ragged per-rank batch sizes are refused before any large gather
